demo: read-only live call made by the AstraNL maintainers; not a customer job

client.name: astranl-demo-client
client.transport: streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0, Python standard library urllib

latency_note: latency_ms is the HTTP round trip measured by the client on the AstraNL host itself; astranl.com resolves to that machine, so internet transit is not included
agent_question: Before I approve ASML Holding N.V. as a supplier: is the KvK registration active, does the VAT number pass VIES, and is there any EU sanctions or insolvency hit?
agent_question_note: example question written for this demo; no customer, supplier or order is involved

tool_result.data_policy: verdicts derived from the sources, not register data; read the registration itself at the KVK link

registry.source: KVK Handelsregister, Zoeken API, read live or from a cache of at most 10 minutes

sanctions.source: EU FSD consolidated sanctions list and US Consolidated Screening List

insolvency.meaning: no insolvency publication under this KvK number at checked_at; a bankruptcy takes effect from the start of the day it is declared and can be published later; this says nothing about solvency

name_check.rule: case, punctuation and spacing ignored; one legal-form suffix B.V., BV, N.V., NV, V.O.F., VOF or C.V. at the end ignored; registered names include those of inactive registrations

classes.A: public registry fetched by protocol, no accountable gate
classes.C: accountable access: fetched by protocol under AstraNL registered access, licence and purpose bound

sources.terms: GDPR wherever natural persons appear; standard terms prohibit onward provision and impose additional reuse conditions.
sources.recheck: answer valid only at observed_at; re-read before each consequential action or on a source change signal

sources.terms: onward delivery expressly permitted for informing commercial participants about insolvency; destroy data within six months after proceedings end.
sources.recheck: per consequential action; personal data deleted within six months after proceedings end per CIR terms

sources.terms: public EU list, read from the AstraNL mirror

tool_result.what_this_proves: what the named official sources returned at observed_at for these inputs, and nothing more
what_this_does_not_prove: who may sign or order for the company
that a bank account or IBAN belongs to it
that a document or email you hold is genuine or was sent by this company
tool_result.next_permitted_action: attach check_id and this signed result to your own record, then take your step; if open_questions lists anything, stop and ask a human before paying or signing; repeat the check when it is older than your own tolerance, at most 7 days for a payment

record.how: call record_counterparty_check with check_id within 48 hours when a colleague, approver or auditor must verify this later

verify.what: a colleague, approver or auditor can check later, without trusting AstraNL, that this exact result was recorded at recorded_at
verify.step_1: after record_counterparty_check, call verify_astranl with ref = its reference, or run python3 astranl_verify.py <reference> from https://astranl.com/spec/ ; integrity must PASS or SIGNED_PENDING_INCLUSION
verify.step_2: compute sha256 of the canonical JSON of this result without the keys check_id, record and verify (keys sorted, separators comma and colon, UTF-8, non-ASCII not escaped); it must equal payload.result_sha256 of that record
verify.meaning: a match proves the sources said this at observed_at; it proves nothing about the counterparty beyond that

client_side_check.what: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the tool result without the keys check_id, record and verify, keys sorted, separators comma and colon, UTF-8, non-ASCII not escaped; computed by this demo client
